{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq for each patient
# Do NOT filter out -999 values, because the question is about enrollment, not data quality
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Count unique patients (now one per patient)
num_patients = len(df_dedup)

# Print only the final count
print(num_patients)"}
